note: Shared shader files that deliberately differ from the read-only stable oracle, one entry per path with the reason and the reason it stays. check_oracle_parity.py fails on a shared file that differs without an entry here, and also fails when an entry no longer differs, so this list cannot rot into blanket permission. Vendor modules and the pre-tuning scalar fallbacks are additions, not divergences, and need no entry.

divergences.reason: Adds the key-range split (push words key_block_index/key_block_count). A single-block submission runs the oracle's arithmetic: the split bounds cover the whole key range and the per-key work is unchanged. The recorded attention digests on the oracle device are identical.
Built from the split source above; the single-block path is the oracle's arithmetic, verified by the unchanged attention digests and by attention_kernel_cache_check on the Gen9 target.

Rebuilt from the unchanged GLSL to read the three-word push block the host already pushes (rows, num_value_heads, beta_scale). The oracle module reads two words and drops OLMo Hybrid's 2.0 beta scale, which the forward kernel's own backward kernel applies. At beta_scale 1.0 the rebuilt module is bit-identical to the oracle's.
